_bind_note: PICK ONE. 127.0.0.1:8080 is correct for the Caddy-fronted single node this repo documents (DEPLOYMENT.md 6.3 and 7): Caddy terminates TLS and proxies over loopback, and the installed firewall drops 8080 from anywhere else. It is WRONG for a WireGuard-overlay fleet: enrolled agents reach feluccad at its overlay IP over plain HTTP inside the tunnel, so bind the overlay address instead (e.g. 10.100.0.1:8080) or every agent registration is refused. The host part is honoured now, so this value is the listener, not a hint.
